title: Production rationale for HF-000412 (fictional)
text: Email HF-000412 was sent by Rina Castellano on 2026-03-11. Email HF-000412 asks the pricing team to hold the fuel surcharge at the current rate until the April review. Request 7 seeks documents concerning fuel surcharge pricing decisions made between 2026-01-01 and 2026-06-30. Because the email discusses a fuel surcharge pricing decision within the requested period, the reviewer marked it responsive to Request 7.
